project_metadata.name: KaraokeZero
project_metadata.tagline: The Headless, Ultra-Low Resource PiKaraoke Appliance
project_metadata.repository_strategy: Independent Wrapper/Appliance (Downloads and configures the official PiKaraoke upstream, without forking it)
project_metadata.core_philosophy: Ultra-low resource consumption, headless operation, zero GUI overhead, zero audio latency, and maximum hardware acceleration.
project_metadata.target_hardware: Any Raspberry Pi (Highly optimized for low-spec models like Raspberry Pi Zero W / RPi 3)

hardware_topology.processing_unit: Raspberry Pi Zero W (Booting OS from SD Card)

storage.sd_card_internal: Dedicated strictly to OS, application configs, and lightweight scripts (Wear Leveling Protection: HIGH).
storage.hard_drive_external: USB HDD mounted via fstab to '/mnt/external_hd/karaoke'. Dedicated to local media library, persistent DB SQLite, and yt-dlp download buffer.

hardware_topology.video_output: Mini-HDMI to VGA Adapter connected to a USB-powered LED Monitor.

audio_routing.strategy: Zero CPU Overhead & Zero Mic Latency
audio_routing.extraction: Audio extracted via the P2 (3.5mm) analog output native to the HDMI-to-VGA adapter, leveraging GPU audio passthrough.
audio_routing.mixing: Direct physical connection from the adapter's P2 port to an external Multichannel Audio Mixer (e.g., 4-channel analog mixer).
audio_routing.microphones: Connected directly to the external analog mixer. Bypasses the Raspberry Pi completely to guarantee zero software delay.

software_stack.operating_system: Raspberry Pi OS Lite (Legacy 32-bit Bullseye - Headless, No X11/Wayland Desktop Environment)
software_stack.media_player: VLC Media Player (CLI via cvlc wrapper)
software_stack.video_rendering_engine: Direct framebuffer / Hardware Acceleration (mmal_vout for Legacy Bullseye OS)

module_1_wifi_manager.purpose: Dynamic and lightweight captive-style portal for network selection without a monitor.
logic_flow: 1. NetworkManager is pre-configured to prioritize the Admin's Mobile Hotspot (Priority 100).
2. If no known venue WiFi is found, Pi connects to the Admin Hotspot.
3. User accesses Flask Web UI via smartphone (e.g., http://<admin-ip>:8888).
4. Flask app executes 'nmcli -t -f SSID,SIGNAL dev wifi' and displays a clean HTML list.
5. User selects the Venue WiFi and inputs password.
6. Flask app registers new network (Priority 50) and connects, moving Pi to the venue's network.

module_2_orchestrator_daemon.purpose: Background service to monitor PiKaraoke state and manage the physical display seamlessly without X11.
logic_flow: 1. On boot, detect active IP (wlan0). Use 'qrencode' to generate a QR Code (http://<ip>:5555) and save to '/tmp/qrcode.png'.
2. Enter infinite loop polling PiKaraoke API ('http://127.0.0.1:5555/api/queue') every 1-2 seconds.

3. IDLE STATE ('is_playing' == false): Ensure no music cvlc is running. Spawn 'cvlc' playing a local looping background video. Use VLC logo filter ('--sub-source logo --logo-file /tmp/qrcode.png --logo-position 9') to overlay the QR Code directly onto the framebuffer.

4. PLAYING STATE ('is_playing' == true): Kill the idle video instance. Spawn a new 'cvlc' instance rendering the requested track (local or downloaded) via hardware acceleration ('--fullscreen --no-osd --vout mmal_vout').
5. Track ends -> VLC auto-closes -> Daemon detects 'is_playing' == false -> Re-spawns IDLE STATE.

module_3_installer_script.purpose: Automated 'One-Click' deployment script to transform a fresh OS into the KaraokeZero Appliance.
actions: Install dependencies: vlc, python3-flask, network-manager, qrencode, yt-dlp.
Clone official PiKaraoke repository from vicwomg/pikaraoke.
Create and enable systemd services (wifi_manager.service, orchestrator.service, pikaraoke.service) to auto-start on boot.

performance_and_stability_guarantees.ram_management: VLC processes are killed between tracks, preventing memory leaks. No Chromium/browsers exist on the Pi.
performance_and_stability_guarantees.cpu_management: Audio is handled by GPU (HDMI passthrough). Video decoded by GPU hardware block. yt-dlp isolated to external HDD I/O.
performance_and_stability_guarantees.sd_card_protection: All heavy read/write operations (SQLite, downloads, media buffering) are forcefully routed to the external HDD.
